title: Dropbox outage, Nov 20, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Dropbox, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Dropbox is a service many people and businesses use daily, and its status page rated this outage Critical. It lasted about 45 minutes. Dropbox has not said how many people were affected.
who_is_affected: People and teams who use Dropbox's website, apps, API, Paper, Passwords, Dash, Protect, Replay, DocSend or MCP Server, or its support services, between 2:28 PM and 3:13 PM ET on Friday, Nov 20. Everything is shown as operational again.

known.text: Dropbox's status page shows an incident from 2:28 PM to 3:13 PM ET on Nov 20, about 45 minutes.
The status page rated it Critical, with the website, apps and API in major outage along with several other Dropbox services.
Dropbox said the outage was not caused by a cyberattack or by AI acting on its own. This is the company's own statement, not an independent finding.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. Dropbox has not said.
Whether it was a cyberattack. Dropbox says it was not; no independent source has confirmed that.
Whether it has any link to other outages this month. No source shows one.
